company.name: Graphite
company.shortDescription: Graphite is an open source CLI and a code review dashboard.
company.description: Graphite is an open-source CLI and a code review dashboard built for engineers to write and review smaller pull requests, also unblocked, ship faster, create, approve, and ship small, incremental changes. CLI makes creating and submitting stacked changes easy, intuitive commands, first-class support for stacks, git under the hood, API, server, and front-end, security, security program overview, data protection policy, encryption policy, secure software development policy, system audit policy, business continuity & disaster recovery policy, vulnerability & patch management policy.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based code review platform for GitHub that combines pull request management, stacked workflows, AI-assisted review, team collaboration, and merge automation.
productsAndServices.name: Graphite Code Review Platform

productsAndServices.description: An AI-assisted code review service that analyzes pull requests for bugs, logical errors, security and performance issues, and organization-specific coding patterns.
productsAndServices.name: Graphite Agent

productsAndServices.description: A command-line Git interface for creating, managing, visualizing, submitting, and synchronizing stacked pull requests.
productsAndServices.name: Graphite CLI

productsAndServices.description: A stack-aware merge automation service that merges pull requests in order, maintains a green main branch, and reduces redundant CI execution.
productsAndServices.name: Graphite Merge Queue

productsAndServices.description: A developer productivity analytics service that reports historical metrics on pull requests, reviews, and engineering workflow performance.
productsAndServices.name: Graphite Insights

productsAndServices.description: A Visual Studio Code extension for creating, modifying, submitting, visualizing, and synchronizing stacked pull requests from within the IDE.
productsAndServices.name: Graphite Visual Studio Code Extension
